  on Bob's certificate is 110, show how Alice can verify the signature. Assume Alice  
  A)          retrieves the hash of Bob's certificate as 12.  
  
  B)          Scenario: An e-commerce platform has implemented a public key infrastructure (PKI)  
  to secure transactions between buyers and sellers. The platform uses digital certificates  
  issued by a trusted certificate authority (CA) to authenticate users and encrypt  
  transactions.  
  i) Explain the key components of the PKI used by the e-commerce platform. How do  
  these components work together to ensure secure communication between users?                 (5)  
  ii) Imagine a situation where a seller's private key is compromised. Discuss the role of  
  the certificate revocation list (CRL) and how the e-commerce platform can notify users  
  about the revocation of the seller's digital certificate. What steps should users take to  
  ensure their transactions remain secure?
